constraint: One artwork file per identity shared between catalogue and home screen. No separate home-screen facility.

args.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: one square opaque icon, used unchanged both as a 64px story-catalogue illustration and as a mobile home-screen icon.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the existing Creation mosaic.
Primary request: retain this exact rich luminous mosaic composition but extend it seamlessly to fill a complete square. Replace the transparent area outside the circular boundary by continuing the artwork naturally into all four corners. Remove the circular perimeter as a visible boundary: the result is one continuous edge-to-edge mosaic picture.
Invariants: preserve the star's location above and left of centre, the sweeping gold/ivory rays, the blue curling wave on the left, the green branching plant and gold bird on the right, the small fish below, the gold ochre earth and the rich indigo/teal/emerald/amber palette. Retain the original glazing, irregular ceramic/glass tesserae, fine gold joints, intensity and integrated shapes. Preserve the existing broad composition and relative scale as closely as possible. Extend the current design rather than zooming in or stretching the circle into a square.
The upper left corner continues deep blue/violet glass and radiating pattern, upper right continues the light/green glass, lower left continues water, lower right continues earth/foliage. Fill every edge and corner with finished artwork.
Output: a single flat square icon asset, fully opaque, with straight square corners. No transparency, surrounding margin, medallion rim, frame, border, rounded corners, text, label, device mockup or comparison layout. The operating system will apply its own corner mask.

Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: one square opaque app identity icon for the educational combination game Make Something Worthwhile; it must work at home-screen size and as a tiny favicon.
Input image 1 is a STYLE AND IDENTITY REFERENCE: the existing handmade gold, ivory and teal mosaic sun. Redesign this motif for a square, retaining its tactile ceramic and glass material character.
Create a much simpler, confident radiant sun/spark assembled from a few broad gold and warm ivory ceramic pieces on a deep petrol-teal ground filling the entire square. The background should be calm and nearly uniform in value, with subtle glaze texture and at most a few broad unobtrusive joins; it is the actual square ground, not a circle or disc. The central golden light is assembled from approximately three irregular fitted gold pieces; around it, six broad short tapering rays in ivory and gold create a readable, gently organic sun/spark, less curled than the original. Small handcut irregularities and fine joints communicate separate pieces becoming a beautiful whole. Keep the overall motif balanced, centered and approximately 70 percent of the canvas width, with generous quiet teal around all sides.
Tone: inviting, thoughtful, luminous, handmade. A graphic silhouette with tactile material, not shiny 3D rendering. Rich honey gold and warm ivory against deep teal; avoid nearly black navy. Material texture remains secondary to the bold simple silhouette.
Output: one complete flat square icon asset, opaque colour edge to edge, straight square corners. No enclosing medallion, dark circular disc, ring, border, white surround, cast shadow, perspective, text, letters, tools, hands, tiny decorative objects, device mockup or comparison layout. Do not pre-round the corners.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: one square opaque app icon colour study.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the freshly drafted gold and ivory mosaic sun on deep teal.
Create its warm-ivory-background counterpart while keeping the same composition, exact sun shape, six ray shapes, scale, centering, seams and handmade glazed ceramic/glass medium.
Change the deep teal background across the entire square to warm ivory ceramic, approximately #F1E5CB, with gentle low-contrast glaze texture and restrained broad joints. Change the four ivory rays to deep petrol teal glass, matching the earlier background hue. Keep the two gold rays and the three fitted golden central pieces honey gold. Keep clear dark fine joints where gold meets ivory so the complete sun remains legible at 64px.
Preserve the central motif's overall silhouette and location; this is a controlled colour/material comparison, not a different symbol. Keep the pattern calm, tactile and graphically readable.
Output one complete opaque square icon, colour to all four edges, straight square corners. No circular backdrop, medallion rim, border, external white margin, rounded corners, drop shadow, text, label, device mockup or comparison layout. Do not add decorative objects.
